subject.title: fix(macos): refresh skills after local node reconnect

question: Which of the two open reconnect-refresh candidates should be retained as the single canonical fix for the macOS Skills stale-status bug?
rationale: Both candidates address the same linked report, but neither has sufficient real macOS proof and the supplied evidence does not establish a current-main ownership history that would safely choose one automatically.

options.title: Select after native proof
options.body: Require each viable candidate to provide redacted macOS after-fix evidence, then retain the narrower verified implementation and close the other as superseded.

options.title: Adopt the older candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107660 as the landing path if its existing validation and native proof are completed first.

options.title: Adopt this candidate
options.body: Use this PR if its native proof is completed and maintainers prefer its dependency-injection and coalescing structure after a full side-by-side review.

recommendation.title: Select after native proof
recommendation.body: Require each viable candidate to provide redacted macOS after-fix evidence, then retain the narrower verified implementation and close the other as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: The author of the overlapping implementation is the strongest available routing candidate for a side-by-side technical comparison; final selection remains a maintainer decision.
